summary: Thorough backend + frontend testing of Noor & Vaani 5-product redesign. Backend pytest (4/4) passed against the public preview URL. Frontend covered homepage (hero, 3D canvas present, all 10 funnel sections, showcase prices incl. lantern ₹1,899, compare table, 3 bundle cards, FAQ accordion), bundles page (all 3 prices + savings), cart drawer + upsell logic (fairy lights ₹349 -> shipping-remaining ₹650, bundle add shows cart-upsell with 2 products not in bag), newsletter success + GLOW10 code, help FAB -> popover -> /pages/contact link, nav + mobile menu (5 product links) + footer (bundles + 5 footer-product-*), search for toran/diya, wishlist toggle+badge, all 5 PDPs render required blocks, variant price switches (toran Wide=₹699, fairy Battery=₹399, giftbox Grand=₹2,499), lantern 'Set of 6' option disabled, ATC adds correct variant label (Champagne Gold · Set of 4), mobile sticky-atc-bar visible after scroll, no horizontal overflow at 390px, collections counts (shop-all 5/5, gifting 3/3, legacy /collections/lights falls back to 5), 404 renders, About + FAQ pages render with updated copy. 0 console errors observed across all pages.

issues: Grid DOM shows 6 product-card-* elements for a 3-product collection — likely due to a related/recommended block below the grid also using the same testid prefix. Textual counter correctly reads 'Showing 3 of 3'. Consider scoping product-card-* testids to the main grid only, or wrap related products in a container with a distinct testid prefix to improve testability.

critical_code_review_comments: Backend /api/newsletter validates email with a regex (ok) but relies on `str` for email field; using Pydantic EmailStr would reject malformed inputs at schema level (422 is already returned manually, so low-pri).

Product.jsx variant option buttons on PDP use `data-testid=variant-option-{option}-{label-slug}` which is good; however `[data-testid^="variant-"]` catches many unrelated nodes (variant-picker, variant-selected-*). Consider using more specific prefix like `variant-option-` consistently in docs for testers.

Collection pages: product cards in related/recommendation strips share the `product-card-{slug}` testid prefix with the main grid, inflating counts. Scope related-section cards under a distinct testid prefix (e.g. `related-card-*`) to avoid ambiguity in automation.
seed_data_creation: Newsletter test emails inserted (TEST uuid prefix) into Mongo via /api/newsletter during pytest; harmless demo data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 12 feature points in the review request were verified end-to-end against the public preview URL. The only 'failures' encountered during initial run were false positives from loose selectors (variant-* prefix matched too broadly, product-card-* prefix includes related-products strip, Showing-5-of-5 split by VWO span). Re-running with scoped selectors or innerText regex (`Showing \d+ of \d+`) all pass. Three.js hero canvas DID render in headless Chromium (canvas inside hero-3d-stage present). No console errors on any route. Help FAB appears after ~3s and links to /pages/contact (WhatsApp number not configured, as expected).
